# Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 83 (Bi-Vb Pc83)

**ID:** Bi-Vb Pc83
**Section:** Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga (bi-vb)
**Collection:** Vinaya
**Title (Pali):** Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 83
**Title (English, from literature):** Ordaining two in the same year
**tipitaka.org (CST):** https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/vin02m1.mul7.xml

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Ekavassa Sutta* (Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 83) sets forth the disciplinary rule prohibiting a Buddhist nun (*bhikkhunī*) from ordaining two women in a single year. According to the origin story analyzed by Ute Hüsken, the narrative setting closely resembles that of the preceding rule, Pācittiya 82; the ordination of candidates without sufficient intervals led to a severe shortage of living space (*vasanokāso na ppahoti*) in the nunnery [Hüsken 1997]. To curb overcrowded lodgings and ensure proper supervision of newly ordained women, the Buddha established that a nun who ordains two candidates within the same year incurs an offense requiring confession (*pācittiya*) [Hüsken 1997]. Modern translations include an English rendering by Bhikkhu Brahmali.

 Text-reuse data computed by DharmaNexus demonstrates extensive formulaic repetition across the Vinaya, identifying 297 matching passages across 93 Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. Its closest internal parallel is Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 82, with which it shares nearly identical introductory and legal phrasing (over 2,600 matching characters across §1.1–2.2.5), alongside substantial reuse in Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 74, 62, and 61 [DharmaNexus]. In cross-language alignments, DharmaNexus detects matches with the Tibetan translation of the *Bhikṣuṇīvinayavibhaṅga* (Degé D0005) and the *Āryasarvāstivādimūlabhikṣuṇīpratimokṣasūtravṛtti* (D4112), as well as partial overlaps with the Sanskrit *Śayanāsanavastu* [DharmaNexus].
